2607.04872.title: EventCoT: Event-centric Video Chain-of-thought for Reasoning Temporal Localization
2607.04872.paper_summary: Reasoning temporal localization (RTL) requires a model to generate an answer that itself contains the time interval supporting it, so high-level reasoning and precise temporal grounding must be produced jointly in a single response. To tackle this challenging task, we propose the first event-centric video chain-of-thought framework, dubbed EventCoT. EventCoT first performs event-centric tokenization of the input video to convert it into compact event tokens, enabling efficient identification of question-relevant events. It then reasons within the identified events to generate the answer, grounding the time interval via embedding matching that aligns placeholder tokens with visual embeddings. EventCoT achieves state-of-the-art results on ActivityNet-RTL for reasoning temporal localization while using substantially fewer visual tokens than previous work. To verify its general performance, we further evaluate EventCoT on the grounded video question answering benchmark ReXTime, where it attains strong zero-shot results.
2607.04872.paper_summary_zh: 推理時間定位（RTL）要求模型生成的答案本身包含支持它的時間區間，因此高階推理和精確的時間基礎必須在單一回應中共同產生。為了應對這一挑戰性任務，我們提出了首個以事件為中心的視頻思維鏈框架，稱為EventCoT。EventCoT首先對輸入視頻進行以事件為中心的標記化，將其轉換為緊湊的事件標記，從而實現對問題相關事件的高效識別。然後，它在識別出的事件中進行推理以生成答案，通過嵌入匹配將佔位符標記與視覺嵌入對齊來確定時間區間。EventCoT在ActivityNet-RTL上實現了推理時間定位的最先進結果，同時使用的視覺標記顯著少於之前的工作。為了驗證其通用性能，我們進一步在基於視頻的問題回答基準ReXTime上評估EventCoT，在該基準上它獲得了強大的零樣本結果。
